name: Forza Horizon 6
description: Forza Horizon 6: a UDP "Data Out" listener that cuts circuit, sprint and free-roam laps; car classes, PI and route types.

steps: In FH6: Settings > HUD and Gameplay > Data Out On, IP 127.0.0.1, port 5300.
Run logger/start_logger.bat while you drive (logger/probe.bat checks the stream). Laps go to data/fh6.

filters.discipline_tip: Tip: set an FH6 route's type (Road, Dirt, Street…) with its ✎ button to filter by it.

ui.picture_hint: (a screenshot works: it is shrunk to about 30 KB)

notes.track_status: FH6 rewind-free does not certify track limits.
notes.route_names: FH6 routes are named by the logger or the user

provenance.steer: derived: the game's steering input x an assumed wheel lock
provenance.position: direct world x/z (z flipped to AC's frame)
provenance.tyre slip: the game's normalised slip (1.0 = grip limit)
provenance.valid: rewind/reset detection only; FH6 track limits are unverified
provenance.input device: the logger's --device setting, or guessed from each lap's pedal and steering data (FH6 doesn't report it)
